text: ∀x (Satellite(x) ∧ OrbitsEarth(x) ∧ TransmitsAndReceivesData(x) → EnablesWeatherForecasting(x) ∧ EnablesGlobalPositioning(x) ∧ EnablesCommunication(x)) ::: A satellite orbits Earth, transmitting and receiving data, enabling services such as weather forecasting, global positioning, and communication.
